tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 1 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_nobility_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 2 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_clergy_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 3 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_burghers_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 4 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_peasants_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 5 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_tribes_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 6 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_dhimmi_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 7 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_cossacks_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 8 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_scholarly_community_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 9 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_public_opinion_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 10 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_court_bureaucrats_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 11 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_maritime_merchants_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 12 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_professional_military_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 13 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_religious_reformers_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 14 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_local_autonomy_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 15 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_minorities_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 16 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_artists_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 17 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_foreign_power_seated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 18 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_group_great_scientist_seated
			remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_seated
		}
	}
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group
	remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance

					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 14 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 5
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 15 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 5
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 16 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 5
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 17 }
		tv_academy_debate_set_selected_foreign_stance_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 18 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 5
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8
					var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_set_selected_foreign_stance_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 3 }
	scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_rival_of = root }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:meritocracy
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:renaissance
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:banking
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:new_world
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 5 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:printing_press
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:confessionalism
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:global_trade
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9 }
				has_embraced_institution = institution:scientific_revolution
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_banking_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_new_world_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {

			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_confessionalism_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}

				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_manufactories_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_scientific_revolution_conservative
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 1 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 2 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 3 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_banking_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 4 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_new_world_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {

				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 6 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_confessionalism_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 7 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_global_trade_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 8 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_manufactories_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = { var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= 9 }
				has_variable = tv_academy_debate_scientific_revolution_progressive
			}
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { opinion = { target = root value >= 1 } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { opinion = { target = root value < 0 } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 2 } }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_price_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 1 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 2 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 3 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 4 } }
		1 = { set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_price value = 5 } }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_seated_group_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group ?= 18 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group ?= 18 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group ?= 18 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group ?= 18 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group ?= 18 } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_prepare_join_event_effect = {
	tv_academy_debate_clear_event_state_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_pick_unseated_any_group_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		tv_academy_debate_prepare_selected_special_scope_effect = yes
		tv_academy_debate_set_stance_for_selected_group_effect = yes
		tv_academy_debate_pick_seat_for_selected_stance_effect = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.100 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_prepare_quarrel_event_effect = {
	tv_academy_debate_clear_event_state_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_pick_unseated_support_group_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group
		tv_academy_debate_pick_unseated_oppose_group_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat_2 value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_group_2 value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat_2 }
		remove_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_seat_2
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_stance_2 value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.104 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_prepare_selected_special_scope_effect = {
	clear_saved_scope = tv_academy_debate_selected_artist
	clear_saved_scope = tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country
	clear_saved_scope = tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 16 }
		random_character = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes is_artist = yes }
			save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_selected_artist
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 17 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_allied_with = { target = root }
					is_neighbor_of = root
					is_rival_of = root
					is_at_war_with = root
				}
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 18 }
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { save_scope_as = tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_count_seated_sides_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_left_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_right_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_left_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_left_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_right_count add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_right_count add = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_right_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group }
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_left_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group }
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_any_empty_seat_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 2 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 3 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 4 }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 5 }
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_pick_seat_for_selected_stance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_stance ?= 1 }
		tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_right_seat_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_stance ?= 2 }
		tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_left_seat_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		tv_academy_debate_count_seated_sides_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_left_count < var:tv_academy_debate_right_count }
			tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_left_seat_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_right_count < var:tv_academy_debate_left_count }
			tv_academy_debate_pick_empty_right_seat_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_event_seat value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			tv_academy_debate_pick_any_empty_seat_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_assign_selected_group_to_seat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 17 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country } }
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_selected_special_scope_effect = yes
		}
		tv_academy_debate_set_selected_foreign_stance_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_event_seat } }
		tv_academy_debate_pick_seat_for_selected_stance_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_seat ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_group value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_group }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_stance value = var:tv_academy_debate_event_stance }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown value = 60 }
		if = { limit = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_artist } set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_artist value = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_artist } }
		if = { limit = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country } set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_foreign_country value = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_foreign_country } }
		if = { limit = { exists = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist } set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_scientist value = scope:tv_academy_debate_selected_scientist } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_group_nobility_seated value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 2 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_group_clergy_seated value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_group ?= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_group_burghers_seated value = 1 }

tv_academy_debate_apply_selected_price_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 1 }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 2 }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 3 }
		add_prestige = -10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 4 }
		add_legitimacy = -5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_event_price ?= 5 }
		add_stability = -7
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_cleanup_invalid_special_seats_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_artist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_artist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_scientist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_scientist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_foreign_country NOT = { country_exists = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_foreign_country } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_1_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_artist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_artist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_2_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_scientist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_scientist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_2_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_foreign_country NOT = { country_exists = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_foreign_country } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_2_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_artist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_artist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_3_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_scientist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_scientist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_3_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_foreign_country NOT = { country_exists = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_foreign_country } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_3_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_artist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_artist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_4_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_scientist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_scientist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_4_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_foreign_country NOT = { country_exists = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_foreign_country } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_4_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_artist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_artist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_5_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_scientist NOT = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_scientist ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_5_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_foreign_country NOT = { country_exists = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_foreign_country } }
		tv_academy_debate_clear_seat_5_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_decrement_cooldowns_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_1_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_2_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_3_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_4_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_academy_debate_seat_5_cooldown add = -1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_apply_monthly_progress_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta value = 0 }
	set_variable = {
		name = tv_academy_debate_seat_contribution
		value = {
			value = "estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)"
			multiply = 0.1
		}
	}
	change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta add = var:tv_academy_debate_seat_contribution }
	tv_academy_debate_apply_seat_1_monthly_progress_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_apply_seat_2_monthly_progress_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_apply_seat_3_monthly_progress_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_apply_seat_4_monthly_progress_effect = yes
	tv_academy_debate_apply_seat_5_monthly_progress_effect = yes
	change_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position add = var:tv_academy_philosophy_monthly_delta }
	clamp_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position min = 0 max = 100 }
}

tv_academy_debate_dispatch_monthly_event_effect = {
	random_list = {
		5 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_join_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_seated_group_that_can_leave_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_leave_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_support_price_join_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_oppose_price_stay_out_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_has_two_empty_seats_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_quarrel_event_effect = yes
		}
		2 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_dip_at_least_80_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_scientist_sways_support_event_effect = yes
		}
		2 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_dip_at_most_30_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_scientist_angers_oppose_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_dip_between_30_and_80_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_scientist_bargain_support_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_available_for_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_great_scientist_requests_seat_event_effect = yes
		}
		2 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_empty_seat_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_royal_appointment_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_neutral_seated_group_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_neutral_decides_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_neutral_seated_group_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_neutral_price_support_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_neutral_seated_group_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_neutral_price_not_oppose_event_effect = yes
		}
		2 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_neutral_seated_group_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_dip_at_least_80_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_scientist_sways_neutral_event_effect = yes
		}
		2 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_neutral_seated_group_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_dip_at_most_30_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_scientist_angers_neutral_event_effect = yes
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = {
				tv_academy_debate_has_neutral_seated_group_trigger = yes
				tv_academy_debate_great_scientist_dip_between_30_and_80_trigger = yes
			}
			tv_academy_debate_prepare_scientist_bargain_neutral_event_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_academy_debate_group_nobility_positive_defection_condition_trigger = {
	estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate > 0.8
}

tv_academy_debate_group_nobility_negative_defection_condition_trigger = {
	estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate < 0.2
}

tv_academy_debate_group_clergy_positive_defection_condition_trigger = {
	religious_unity > 0.9
}

tv_academy_debate_group_clergy_negative_defection_condition_trigger = {
	religious_unity < 0.5
}

tv_academy_debate_group_burghers_positive_defection_condition_trigger = {
	monthly_trade_income > { value = monthly_income_total multiply = 0.5 }
}

tv_academy_philosophy_check_debate_endpoint_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position >= 100
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_phase value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_research.43 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_debate_position <= 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue value = var:tv_academy_philosophy_current }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_academy_philosophy_phase value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_research.44 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_resolve_pending_acceptance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue
		}
		tv_academy_debate_apply_acceptance_seat_results_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_apply_pending_acceptance_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_clear_debate_result_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_resolve_pending_rejection_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_kind ?= 2
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_current ?= var:tv_academy_philosophy_result_issue
		}
		tv_academy_debate_apply_rejection_seat_results_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_advance_current_issue_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_enter_recess_effect = yes
		tv_academy_philosophy_clear_debate_result_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_academy_philosophy_apply_monthly_debate_drift_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_academy_philosophy_phase ?= 1
			var:tv_academy_debate_current_node_type ?= 1
			tv_academy_philosophy_has_current_issue_trigger = yes
			NOT = { tv_academy_philosophy_current_issue_embraced_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_result_pending }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_academy_philosophy_recess_notice_pending }
		}
		trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_academy_debate.1 days = 1 }
	}
}
